acceptance.given: A migrated fixture has explicit owner-specific authority fields in its before state.

oracle.expected: The fixture comparison records the owner-specific authority fields as unchanged between the before and after states.
forbidden: Owner-specific authority fields drift between the explicit before and after fixture states.
Validation discards or replaces owner-specific authority fields.
oracle.observable: The migration fixture comparison output contains the before and after owner-specific authority fields.

acceptance.then: The compared owner-specific authority fields are unchanged.
acceptance.when: Validate the migrated fixture and compare its explicit before and after owner-specific authority fields.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the migrated-fixture comparison when owner-specific authority fields differ or are missing between the before and after states.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure migrated-fixture validation compares explicit before and after owner-specific authority fields and detects drift.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain validator interfaces and existing fixture fields; reverting comparison behavior must not alter persisted package data.

slice_hint.state_transition: Migrated fixture with explicit before and after authority fields -> validation comparison result identifying preserved fields or drift.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The comparison output establishes whether owner-specific authority fields are unchanged, and reports drift when they differ.

acceptance.given: An inspected package is provided to the validator, with its contents available for before and after comparison.

oracle.expected: The inspected package contents are unchanged after validation.
forbidden: The validator modifies, rewrites, or persists changes to the inspected package.
Validation changes the package under inspection.
oracle.observable: A before and after comparison of the inspected package contents shows no validation-induced changes.

acceptance.then: The inspected package remains unchanged after validation.
acceptance.when: Run validation and compare the inspected package contents before and after execution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a validation run when comparison shows that validation modified, rewrote, or persisted changes to the inspected package.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure validation leaves the inspected package unchanged.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain validator interfaces and diagnostics while ensuring validation does not write to the inspected package.

slice_hint.state_transition: Inspected package before validation -> validation execution -> inspected package after validation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The package comparison shows no validation-induced change to the inspected package.

acceptance.given: A migration fixture or composition check is being defined or reported.

oracle.expected: The check is described as a fixture/composition check, without claiming that the static validator infers arbitrary Skill semantics.
forbidden: The migration fixture or composition check is presented as proof that the static validator can infer arbitrary Skill semantics.
oracle.observable: The check definition or report identifies fixture/composition scope and contains no arbitrary-Skill-semantic inference claim.

acceptance.then: The check is represented as fixture/composition validation, not arbitrary Skill semantic inference.
acceptance.when: Inspect the migration check definition or report for its stated scope and claims.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the migration check definition or report when it claims arbitrary Skill semantic inference from the fixture or composition check.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Keep migration-check definitions and reports within the stated fixture/composition scope.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve validator interfaces and report structure while maintaining the fixture/composition scope boundary.

slice_hint.state_transition: Migration check definition or report -> scope and claims review.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The check definition or report states fixture/composition scope and makes no arbitrary Skill semantic inference claim.

acceptance.given: The inspected package has no quality sidecar.

oracle.expected: Validation does not treat the absent sidecar as a silent pass and reports an explicit non-pass outcome or missing-sidecar diagnostic.
forbidden: Validation reports pass solely because the quality sidecar is absent.
The absence of a quality sidecar is silently accepted as a passing result.
oracle.observable: The validation result status and diagnostics show that the absent sidecar was not silently accepted as pass.

acceptance.then: The absent quality sidecar produces a non-silent, non-pass outcome.
acceptance.when: Validate the inspected package and inspect the result status and diagnostics for the absent-sidecar case.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the absent-quality-sidecar validation case when it returns pass without an explicit missing-sidecar diagnostic.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure an absent quality sidecar cannot be silently treated as pass.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the validation result contract while ensuring an absent quality sidecar is reported as an explicit non-pass outcome.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package without quality sidecar -> validation result with explicit non-pass outcome or diagnostic.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation does not report a silent pass when the quality sidecar is absent.
